question: Simplify: (tan² theta - sin² theta)/(2 + tan² theta + cot² theta)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Put θ = 45°. We know tan 45° = 1, cot 45° = 1, sin 45° = 1/√2

Numerator = 1² − (1/√2)² = 1 − 1/2 = 1/2

Denominator = 2 + 1² + 1² = 4

Expression value = (1/2) ÷ 4 = 1/8

Check options: Only sin⁶ 45° = (1/√2)⁶ = 1/8 matches the expression value.

**∴ The correct answer is sin⁶ θ.**
